title: Home Assistant
description: Shows the state of lights, sensors and other devices from your Home Assistant.

url.title: Home Assistant URL
url.description: The base URL of your local Home Assistant instance.

token.title: Long-Lived Access Token
token.description: Long-Lived Access Token created in your Home Assistant profile settings.

heading.title: Custom Heading
heading.description: Custom title to display as the module header (overrides default).

show_header.title: Show Header
show_header.description: Show or hide the module's header/title.

layout.title: Layout Style
layout.description: Choose between 'detailed' (large display of sensor with sub-values) or 'compact' (vertical dense list of entities with inline metadata).

entities.title: Tracked Entities
entities.description: List of Home Assistant entity IDs to display.

entity_id.title: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The full entity ID from Home Assistant (e.g. sensor.living_room_temp, light.kitchen).

custom_name.title: Custom Name (Optional)
custom_name.description: Override the friendly name from Home Assistant.

custom_icon.title: Custom Icon (Optional)
custom_icon.description: Start typing to pick an icon (e.g. thermometer, lightbulb, house). Empty: one that fits the entity.

group.title: Group Name (Optional)
group.description: Optional name to group this entity under (e.g., 'Climate', 'Security').

show.title: Show on the Mirror
show.description: Show this entity in the card. Untick to keep it only for sharing with other modules.

share.title: Share with Other Modules
share.description: Every update sends the public event mirrordash_homeassistant.<entity id> (e.g. mirrordash_homeassistant.sensor.outdoor_temperature). A sensor with a number sends {"value": 3.4, "unit": "°C", "name": ..., "kind": ...}, anything else {"state": "on", "name": ..., "kind": ...}. Any module can listen, e.g. Weather's outdoor temperature.

extras.title: Extra Readings
extras.description: The entity's other readings, ticked to be shown under its value.

layout.title: Layout Style
layout.description: Visual presentation: as the module's Layout Style, 'detailed' (large single value) or 'compact' (dense list row).

width.title: Width
width.description: CSS width of the module container (e.g., 380px, 100%, 30rem).

height.title: Height
height.description: CSS height of the module container (e.g., auto, 300px, 100%).

interval.title: Update Interval (Seconds)
interval.description: Time to wait between state updates.
